part.text:
Fixed `src/PhpSpreadsheet/Writer/Xlsx/FunctionPrefix.php:36` by adding a negative lookbehind to `XLFNREGEXP`, so function names are only prefixed when not preceded by another identifier character.

`NETWORKDAYS` is now preserved while `DAYS` still becomes `_xlfn.DAYS`:

- `NETWORKDAYS(A1,A2)` → unchanged
- `NETWORKDAYS.INTL(A1,A2)` → `_xlfn.NETWORKDAYS.INTL(...)`
- `ABS(DAYS(A1,A2))` → `ABS(_xlfn.DAYS(A1,A2))`

`FunctionPrefixTest` passes 13/13. Related calculation/writer prefix tests also pass.
